_readme: zh-Hant (Taiwan) term -> zh-Hans (Mainland) term. Applied before OpenCC, longest term first, and the mapped value is used verbatim. Add a term here when OpenCC alone gives a wrong or un-idiomatic Mainland word. The first block pins the site's core vocabulary; the second block fixes words OpenCC gets wrong for this subject. Used by src/i18n/hans.ts and scripts/gen-zh-hans.mjs.
